# infoblox_dtc_monitor_tcp (List Resource)

Retrieves a list of Infoblox DtcMonitorTcp from both the NIOS and UDDI backends.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// List specific DTC Monitor TCPs using filters
list "infoblox_dtc_monitor_tcp" "list_dtc_monitor_tcp_using_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    filters = {
      name = "example_tcp_monitor"
    }
  }
  limit = 10
}

// List specific DTC Monitor TCPs using Extensible Attributes
list "infoblox_dtc_monitor_tcp" "list_dtc_monitor_tcp_using_ext_attr_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    ext_attr_filters = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// List DTC Monitor TCPs with resource details included
list "infoblox_dtc_monitor_tcp" "list_dtc_monitor_tcp_with_resource" {
  provider         = infoblox
  include_resource = true
}
```

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// List specific Dtc Monitor Tcps using filters
list "infoblox_dtc_monitor_tcp" "list_dtc_monitor_tcp_using_filters" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    filters = {
      comment = "DTC TCP monitor creation"
    }
  }
  limit = 10
}

// List specific Dtc Monitor Tcps using Tags
list "infoblox_dtc_monitor_tcp" "list_dtc_monitor_tcp_using_tags" {
  provider = infoblox
  config {
    tag_filters = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}

// List Dtc Monitor Tcps with resource details included
list "infoblox_dtc_monitor_tcp" "list_dtc_monitor_tcp_with_resource" {
  provider         = infoblox
  include_resource = true
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ext_attr_filters` (Map of String) Extensible Attribute Filters are used to filter results by NIOS extensible attributes. Only applicable for the NIOS backend.
- `filters` (Map of String) Filters are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes (e.g. name, view). If multiple filters are specified, only resources that match all of them are returned.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to filter results by UDDI tags. Only applicable for the UDDI backend.
